messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — severity: P2. Streaming frontends report intermittent 5xx for SSE connections + spike in tool-call parse errors. Detected 2025-11-14 18:22:08 UTC. Impact: ~7-10% of active streaming sessions failing to complete tool-call sequences. Paging oncall kevin.h.
kevin.h: taking it. will collect traces and isolate region. tagging @sara_m for parser traces.
sara_m: I see a sudden spike of 'parse_error: unexpected EOF' in sse-parser logs around 18:21:57 UTC. repeat client id=0x3a7 across errors.
anita_r: adding runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/streaming-toolcall (runbook: streaming-toolcall -> mitigation checklist).
dan_t: quick triage idea — can we enable lenient parsing fallback temporarily to reduce customer failures? tradeoff: may accept malformed payloads.
kevin.h: enabling lenient-parse on canary (eu-west-1) at 18:26 for 10% traffic. /deploy lenient-parse-canary -> started.
matt_ops: pulling logs from sse-parser around window:
```
[18:21:57 UTC] sse-parser: client=0x3a7 fd=92 recv=chunked
[18:21:57 UTC] sse-parser ERROR parse_error unexpected EOF toolcall payload id=tc-1982
[18:22:01 UTC] sse-router WARN disconnect 502 upstream=ingest-gateway
[18:22:04 UTC] ingest-gateway: p99=1.2s, drop=0.4% under short burst
```
anita_r: hypothesis A — some clients using SDK v0.6 are sending chunked toolcall payloads where the final JSON closing brace is lost at chunk boundaries. Hypothesis B — an edge-proxy header rewrite (recent minor change) is truncating SSE frames under p99 latency.
sara_m: correlating deploys: infra shows a minor config push to edge-proxies at 18:19 for header rewrite. not a full infra deploy.
infra-bot: rollback job created: job_id=9873 edge-proxies header-rewrite rollback initiated by infra at 18:28 UTC.
client-success-bot: Support reports for Charcoal.ai and NovaDocs — both customers reported degraded streaming starting ~18:23. Both on SDK v0.6. CS is engaged, prepping customer-facing note.
dan_t: mitigation plan: 1) canary lenient parser; 2) rollback edge-proxy header rewrite; 3) reroute affected customers to dedicated streaming pool. implementing step 2 now.
kevin.h: documenting timeline + artifacts in incident doc (draft): https://redwood.internal/incidents/1749998888 — handing to @sara_m at 19:00 UTC. notes: collect full raw SSE frames, sample tool-call payloads, trace upstream ingest-gateway spans for client 0x3a7.
sara_m: will take over at 19:00. RCA todo: gather raw frames, SDK trace, diff of edge-proxy config, check ingest-gateway logs for 421/timeout codes.
matt_ops: extracted sample raw frames for tc-1982 and tc-1991. snippet shows truncated chunk boundary:
```
data: {"type":"tool","name":"search","params":
{"q":"foo","cursor":null}
```
(note: missing trailing '}' on final chunk)
kevin.h: that sample strongly supports Hypothesis A (client-side chunk boundary bug causing unterminated JSON). evidence: repeated truncated frames from same client build, no simultaneous large infra deploys. Action items: 1) SDK patch (0.6.1) to fix chunking/flush behavior — owner @anita_r; 2) parser hardening to accept and repair last-chunk boundaries where safe — owner @dan_t; 3) monitoring/alerting to detect recurrence and affected client versions — owner @matt_ops.
anita_r: PR for SDK patch started, will push 0.6.1 and publish advisory + support template within 2 hours.
client-success-bot: Draft advisory prepared: "We observed intermittent streaming tool-call failures impacting SDK v0.6 on unstable networks. Workaround: upgrade to 0.6.1 when available, or enable client-side retry/backoff. We're rolling a server-side lenient parser as temporary mitigation."
kevin.h: live mitigation status: rollback of edge-proxy complete at 18:35; lenient parser scaled to 100% for affected pool; reroute to dedicated pool applied for Charcoal.ai & NovaDocs. Post-mitigation measured impact <0.5% failed streaming sessions. Marking incident mitigated for customer-facing impact; RCA in-progress. :white_check_mark:
kevin.h: leaving notes for handoff: attach raw frames, parser log slices, ingest-gateway spans, and SDK samples to the incident doc. next oncall @sara_m to continue RCA and coordinate SDK advisory.
sara_m: ack, will continue RCA + final report. timeline, artifacts, and hypothesis table will be in doc. will re-open pager if regressions observed. :mag:
